senses.zh: 生的；未加工的；阴冷的；刺痛的；擦掉皮的；无经验的；（在艺术等方面）不成熟的

ex.en: I prefer raw carrots because they are so crunchy.
ex.zh: 我更喜欢生胡萝卜，因为吃起来很脆。

ex.en: Countries that export mainly raw materials may be vulnerable to sudden changes in global commodity prices.
ex.zh: 主要出口原材料的国家可能容易受到全球大宗商品价格骤变的冲击。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。raw强调未烹煮或未加工，不等于“新鲜的”fresh。

senses.zh: 猛然打开；裂开；突然打开

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 号召；指名要(某人)去干(某事)；请求；访问

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 突出；伸出手臂；伸展；(因为与众不同而)容易识别

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 三藩市；圣弗朗西斯科；美国旧金山

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 打，打击；罢工；敲，敲击；抓；打动；穿透
打，击；罢工；撞击，冲击；侵袭；打动；到达

ex.en: The drivers are on strike, so we walked home.
ex.zh: 司机们正在罢工，所以我们走路回了家。

ex.en: Workers may go on strike when negotiations over pay and working conditions fail.
ex.zh: 当有关薪酬和工作条件的谈判失败时，工人可能会举行罢工。

col: strike someone as unusual｜让某人觉得不寻常
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。过去式struck；过去分词通常也用struck。

ex.en: We stayed indoors as the typhoon shook the windows.
ex.zh: 台风把窗户震得直响，我们一直待在室内。

ex.en: Coastal communities need stronger buildings and reliable warning systems to reduce damage caused by typhoons.
ex.zh: 沿海社区需要更坚固的建筑和可靠的预警系统，以减少台风造成的破坏。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。与hurricane均指热带气旋，名称因发生海域而异。

ex.en: Water gushed from the broken pipe beneath the sink.
ex.zh: 水从水槽下方破裂的管道里喷涌而出。

ex.en: When ageing pipes burst, clean water can gush into streets, wasting resources and disrupting local transport.
ex.zh: 老化的管道爆裂时，清水会涌上街道，浪费资源并扰乱当地交通。

col: gush from a pipe｜从管道中喷出
gush about something｜对某事赞不绝口
a gush of water｜一股涌出的水
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。谈论人时，gush about常暗示赞美过于热情。

ex.en: The mountain road was closed after an avalanche overnight.
ex.zh: 夜里发生雪崩后，那条山路被封闭了。

ex.en: Mountain communities need reliable warning systems to reduce the risks that avalanches pose to residents and visitors.
ex.zh: 山区社区需要可靠的预警系统，以降低雪崩对居民和游客构成的风险。

col: an avalanche of complaints｜大量涌来的投诉
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。an avalanche of后接复数或不可数名词，表示大量涌来。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B

senses.zh: 紧急情况；突发事件；非常时刻

ex.en: Keep a torch nearby in case of an emergency.
ex.zh: 在手边备好手电筒，以防出现紧急情况。

ex.en: Governments should invest in emergency services to ensure that communities receive rapid assistance during natural disasters.
ex.zh: 政府应投资应急服务，确保社区在自然灾害期间迅速获得援助。

col: in an emergency｜在紧急情况下
a state of emergency｜紧急状态
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。是可数名词；emergency exit中的名词作定语。

senses.zh: 安全的；无虑的；有把握的；稳当的
获得安全；船抛锚；停止工作

ex.en: Check that the ladder is secure before climbing up.
ex.zh: 爬上去之前，检查梯子是否稳固。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that citizens have secure access to clean water during periods of drought.
ex.zh: 政府应确保公民在干旱期间能可靠地获得清洁用水。

col: secure a job｜获得一份工作
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。secure可作形容词，也可作及物动词表示争取到。

ex.en: We keep our bicycles in the basement during winter.
ex.zh: 冬天我们把自行车放在地下室里。

ex.en: Converting unused basement space into community facilities can help densely populated neighbourhoods accommodate more activities.
ex.zh: 将闲置的地下室空间改造成社区设施，有助于人口密集的街区容纳更多活动。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。basement可作居住空间；cellar通常指地下储藏室。

senses.zh: 固体的；可靠的；立体的；结实的；一致的

ex.en: The lake froze solid during the bitterly cold night.
ex.zh: 在那个严寒的夜晚，湖面完全冻住了。

ex.en: Governments need solid evidence before introducing policies that could significantly affect public health and household spending.
ex.zh: 政府在出台可能显著影响公共卫生和家庭开支的政策前，需要可靠的证据。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。solid作名词指固体；solid evidence表示可靠证据。

ex.en: We moved the furniture to make room for dancing.
ex.zh: 我们挪开家具，腾出地方跳舞。

ex.en: Buying second-hand furniture can lower household expenses while reducing demand for raw materials and limiting waste.
ex.zh: 购买二手家具既能降低家庭开支，也能减少原材料需求和废弃物。

col: a piece of furniture｜一件家具
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。不可数：一件家具说a piece of furniture。

ex.en: The torch needs a new battery before our trip.
ex.zh: 出发旅行前，这只手电筒需要换一节新电池。

ex.en: Improved battery technology could make electric vehicles more affordable and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 电池技术的进步可以降低电动汽车的价格，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。

col: a battery of tests｜一系列测试
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。复数为batteries；a battery of可指一系列测试。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B

senses.zh: 强烈的；紧张的；非常的；热情的

ex.en: The intense heat made us search for shade.
ex.zh: 酷热让我们四处寻找阴凉处。

ex.en: Intense competition for university places can place considerable psychological pressure on students during their final school year.
ex.zh: 大学入学名额的激烈竞争，可能给毕业年级学生带来相当大的心理压力。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。intense 强调程度强烈；intensive 强调密集投入。

ex.en: We turned back after the guide's warning about slippery rocks.
ex.zh: 听到向导提醒岩石湿滑后，我们折返了。

ex.en: Effective flood warning systems allow residents to leave dangerous areas before roads become impossible to use.
ex.zh: 有效的洪水预警系统能让居民在道路无法通行前撤离危险区域。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。warning是名词，也可作warn的现在分词。

ex.en: My waterproof jacket kept me dry during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中，我的防水夹克让我没有淋湿。

ex.en: Outdoor workers need waterproof clothing to remain comfortable and protected when carrying out tasks in wet weather.
ex.zh: 户外工作者需要防水衣物，以便在潮湿天气作业时保持舒适并得到保护。

col: waterproof a roof｜给屋顶做防水
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。water-resistant仅指有一定抗水能力，防水程度较弱。

ex.en: Keep the leftover rice in a container with a lid.
ex.zh: 把剩米饭放在有盖的容器里。

ex.en: Reusable food containers can reduce household waste when people use them instead of disposable packaging.
ex.zh: 人们用可重复使用的食品容器代替一次性包装，可以减少家庭垃圾。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。泛指盛装东西的容器；运输语境常指集装箱。

senses.en: relating to high mountains, especially the Alps

ex.en: Tiny alpine flowers grew between rocks beside the trail.
ex.zh: 小小的高山花朵生长在小径旁的岩石缝中。

ex.en: Rising temperatures threaten alpine ecosystems by reducing snow cover and forcing mountain species to move higher.
ex.zh: 气温上升使积雪覆盖减少，并迫使山地物种向更高处迁移，从而威胁高山生态系统。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。泛指高山环境用小写；专指阿尔卑斯山常大写。

senses.zh: 斜坡；倾斜；斜率；扛枪姿势

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B

ex.en: Please put the camping equipment back in the garage.
ex.zh: 请把露营装备放回车库。

ex.en: Schools need suitable laboratory equipment to give students practical experience and encourage an interest in science.
ex.zh: 学校需要合适的实验室设备，让学生获得实践经验并培养科学兴趣。

col: a piece of equipment｜一件设备
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。不可数；一件设备说a piece of equipment。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B

ex.en: Please ensure that all windows are closed before leaving.
ex.zh: 离开前请确保所有窗户都已关好。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that affordable public transport is available to residents in both urban and rural areas.
ex.zh: 政府应确保城市和农村居民都能享有价格实惠的公共交通。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。ensure接名词或that从句；insure指投保。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B

ex.en: A green frog jumped into the pond beside our house.
ex.zh: 一只绿青蛙跳进了我们屋旁的池塘。

ex.en: Creating ponds in urban parks can provide valuable habitats for amphibians and increase local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市公园中建造池塘可以为两栖动物提供宝贵的栖息地，并增加当地的生物多样性。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。pond通常比lake小；可指天然或人工池塘。

ex.en: A tiny spark flew out of the fireplace.
ex.zh: 壁炉里飞出了一颗小火星。

ex.en: Investment in public libraries can spark interest in reading and provide valuable learning opportunities for disadvantaged children.
ex.zh: 对公共图书馆的投资可以激发阅读兴趣，并为弱势儿童提供宝贵的学习机会。

col: a spark of hope｜一丝希望
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。作动词可直接接interest、debate等，表示“引发”。

senses.zh: 毛毯，毯子；毯状物，覆盖层
总括的，全体的；没有限制的

ex.en: She wrapped a soft blanket around her cold shoulders.
ex.zh: 她用一条柔软的毯子裹住冰凉的肩膀。

ex.en: A blanket ban on private vehicles may disadvantage residents who cannot easily access public transport.
ex.zh: 全面禁止私家车可能使难以使用公共交通的居民处于不利地位。

col: a blanket of snow｜厚厚的一层雪
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。blanket作形容词指全面适用，如blanket ban。

senses.zh: 放出；（通过排泄等）减轻压力

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B

ex.en: The firefighter showed us how to use the hose.
ex.zh: 那位消防员向我们演示了如何使用消防水带。

ex.en: Every firefighter requires regular training to respond safely and effectively to emergencies in increasingly complex urban environments.
ex.zh: 每位消防员都需要定期接受培训，以便在日益复杂的城市环境中安全、有效地应对紧急情况。

col: a trained firefighter｜训练有素的消防员
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。firefighter不区分性别，比fireman更通用。

ex.en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
ex.zh: 我们在车里备有一个急救包。

ex.en: Schools should provide basic science kits so that all pupils can take part in practical experiments.
ex.zh: 学校应提供基础科学实验套件，让所有学生都能参与动手实验。

col: kit someone out｜给某人配齐装备
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。kit指成套用品；kit sb out表示给某人配装备。

ex.en: She used a flashlight to look under the bed.
ex.zh: 她用手电筒照着查看床底。

ex.en: Households should keep a flashlight readily available to improve safety during unexpected power cuts.
ex.zh: 家庭应将手电筒放在随手可取的地方，以提高突发停电时的安全性。

col: turn on a flashlight｜打开手电筒
shine a flashlight｜用手电筒照射
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。手电筒的美式说法；英式通常用torch。

ex.en: There is a first-aid kit in the kitchen cupboard.
ex.zh: 厨房橱柜里有一个急救包。

ex.en: Employers should provide first-aid training so that staff can respond effectively to minor workplace injuries.
ex.zh: 雇主应提供急救培训，让员工能够有效应对工作场所的轻伤。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。名词写作first aid；置于名词前可加连字符。

ex.en: She wore a mask while cleaning the dusty cupboard.
ex.zh: 她清理满是灰尘的橱柜时戴着口罩。

ex.en: Rapid economic growth can mask serious inequalities in access to education and healthcare.
ex.zh: 经济快速增长可能掩盖教育和医疗机会方面的严重不平等。

col: wear a mask｜戴口罩；戴面具
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。mask 作动词直接接宾语，表示掩盖问题或感受。

senses.zh: 环境卫生；卫生设备；下水道设施

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B

senses.zh: 使潮湿；使阻尼；使沮丧，抑制

ex.en: My socks are still damp from yesterday's walk.
ex.zh: 昨天散步后，我的袜子到现在还潮乎乎的。

ex.en: Living in damp conditions can worsen respiratory problems, particularly among children and older people.
ex.zh: 居住环境潮湿可能加重呼吸系统问题，儿童和老年人尤其容易受影响。

col: rising damp｜沿墙上升的地面湿气
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。damp多指令人不适的微湿；moist可用于食物润泽。

ex.en: He wrapped a warm towel around his wet shoulders.
ex.zh: 他把一条温暖的毛巾裹在湿漉漉的肩膀上。

ex.en: Hotels can reduce water consumption by encouraging guests to reuse their towels during their stay.
ex.zh: 酒店可以鼓励住客在入住期间重复使用毛巾，以减少用水量。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。可数名词；paper towel指吸水纸巾，不是布毛巾。

ex.en: I keep the bottle opener in the kitchen drawer.
ex.zh: 我把开瓶器放在厨房抽屉里。

ex.en: The festival opener attracted a diverse audience, demonstrating the growing popularity of local cultural events.
ex.zh: 艺术节的开场演出吸引了不同背景的观众，显示出本地文化活动日益受到欢迎。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B。工具名称常用容器名加opener，如can opener。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B

senses.zh: 菲律宾；菲律宾群岛；菲律宾独立日

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 B

ex.en: The medicine eased her suffering and helped her sleep.
ex.zh: 药物减轻了她的痛苦，让她得以入睡。

ex.en: Improving access to clean water can reduce human suffering in communities affected by prolonged drought.
ex.zh: 改善清洁用水的获取条件，可以减轻长期受干旱影响的社区居民的苦难。

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1。泛指痛苦时通常不可数；sufferings指种种苦难。
📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1

ex.en: I borrowed her best-selling cookbook and tried the soup.
ex.zh: 我借来她那本畅销食谱，试做了里面的汤。

ex.en: Best-selling novels can encourage wider reading, although commercial success does not necessarily indicate literary quality.
ex.zh: 畅销小说能够推动更广泛的阅读，但商业成功并不一定代表文学品质。

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1。best-selling作形容词；bestseller是畅销书或商品。

ex.en: These photos prove that our dog opened the cupboard.
ex.zh: 这些照片证明是我们的狗打开了橱柜。

ex.en: Long-term studies may prove that regular exercise improves concentration as well as physical health.
ex.zh: 长期研究可能证实，经常锻炼既能改善注意力，也能增强身体健康。

col: prove a point｜证明一个观点
prove someone wrong｜证明某人错了
tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1。prove可接that从句，也可直接接形容词。

ex.en: She rolled her wheelchair up the ramp into the library.
ex.zh: 她推着轮椅沿坡道进入了图书馆。

ex.en: Public buildings should provide step-free entrances and spacious lifts so that wheelchair users can move around independently.
ex.zh: 公共建筑应提供无台阶入口和宽敞的电梯，让轮椅使用者能够独立通行。

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1。说a wheelchair user，避免用带有束缚意味的表达。
📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1

senses.zh: 简短的，简洁的；短暂的，草率的

ex.en: We took a brief break before finishing the puzzle.
ex.zh: 我们短暂休息了一下，然后完成了拼图。

ex.en: Teachers should brief students on safety procedures before allowing them to conduct experiments independently.
ex.zh: 教师应先向学生介绍安全操作规程，再允许他们独立进行实验。

col: brief someone on｜向某人介绍……的情况
a design brief｜设计任务说明
tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1。brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。
📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1

ex.en: This software helps me edit photos on my laptop.
ex.zh: 这个软件帮助我在笔记本电脑上编辑照片。

ex.en: Schools need reliable software and adequate teacher training to make effective use of digital learning tools.
ex.zh: 学校需要可靠的软件和充分的教师培训，才能有效利用数字学习工具。

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1。不可数：说some software，不说a software。
📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1
📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1

senses.zh: 霍金；物理学家霍金；史蒂芬霍金

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1

senses.zh: 进场与着陆模拟器（Approach and Landing Simulator）

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1

senses.zh: 珍古德；古道尔；家珍古德

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 1

ex.en: Our teacher showed us a map of global temperatures.
ex.zh: 老师给我们看了一张全球气温分布图。

ex.en: Global cooperation is essential for tackling climate change because environmental damage rarely respects national borders.
ex.zh: 全球合作对于应对气候变化至关重要，因为环境破坏很少受国界限制。

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 2。global强调全球范围；international强调国家之间。

senses.zh: 心态；倾向；习惯；精神状态

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 2

senses.zh: 使用，采用；雇用；使忙于，使从事于

ex.en: The bakery employs three people from our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 这家面包店雇用了我们街区的三个人。

ex.en: Teachers can employ a range of practical activities to help students understand complex scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 教师可以采用一系列实践活动，帮助学生理解复杂的科学概念。

col: employ someone as｜雇用某人担任
tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 2。employ既可指雇人，也可正式地表示采用方法。
📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 3

ex.en: My aunt founded a small charity last winter.
ex.zh: 去年冬天，我姑姑创办了一家小型慈善机构。

ex.en: Graduates who found new businesses can create employment opportunities and introduce innovative services to local communities.
ex.zh: 创办新企业的毕业生可以创造就业机会，并为当地社区引入创新服务。

col: found a charity｜创办慈善机构
tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 3。“创立”的过去式是founded；“找到”的原形是find。

ex.en: My main aim today is to tidy the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我今天的主要目标是把厨房收拾整齐。

ex.en: The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.
ex.zh: 该项目旨在通过提供实践培训和获取职场经验的机会，降低青年失业率。

col: aim to do something｜力求做某事
with the aim of｜以……为目的
aim at a target｜瞄准目标
tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 3。aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。

senses.zh: 慈善事业的；慷慨的，仁慈的；宽恕的

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 3

senses.zh: 基础；地基；基金会；根据；创立

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 3

ex.en: Training with a friend gives me motivation to keep running.
ex.zh: 和朋友一起训练让我有动力坚持跑步。

ex.en: Giving students meaningful choices can increase their motivation and encourage them to take responsibility for learning.
ex.zh: 给予学生有意义的选择，可以提高他们的积极性，并鼓励他们对学习负责。

col: motivation behind a decision｜决定背后的动机
tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 3。动力常不可数；具体动机可数，常接for或behind。

senses.zh: 激发；鼓舞；启示；产生；使生灵感

ex.en: Our coach inspired us to try again after losing.
ex.zh: 输掉比赛后，教练鼓励我们再试一次。

ex.en: Teachers who connect lessons with real problems can inspire students to pursue careers in science.
ex.zh: 将课程与实际问题联系起来的教师能够激励学生投身科学事业。

col: inspire someone to act｜激励某人行动
be inspired by nature｜从自然中获得灵感
tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 3。常用 inspire sb to do sth，表示激励某人做某事。

ex.en: Living far from town makes a car a necessity.
ex.zh: 住得离城镇很远，汽车就成了必需品。

ex.en: The rising cost of housing highlights the necessity of providing affordable homes for low-income families.
ex.zh: 住房成本上涨凸显了为低收入家庭提供可负担住房的必要性。

col: a necessity for｜对……而言的必需品
tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 3。表必要性常不可数；表必需品可数，常用复数。
📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 3

senses.zh: 贫困的；贫穷的；生活艰苦的

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 3

ex.en: We measured the window before buying new curtains.
ex.zh: 我们买新窗帘前量了窗户的尺寸。

ex.en: Governments should introduce effective measures to reduce air pollution without placing excessive costs on low-income households.
ex.zh: 政府应采取有效措施减少空气污染，同时避免让低收入家庭承担过高费用。

col: take measures to do something｜采取措施做某事
a measure of success｜衡量成功的标准
tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 4。采取措施用 take measures；测量某物直接接宾语。

ex.en: Every resident received a key to the shared garden.
ex.zh: 每位住户都拿到了一把公共花园的钥匙。

ex.en: Local residents should be consulted before major changes are made to roads and public spaces.
ex.zh: 在对道路和公共空间进行重大改造之前，应征求当地居民的意见。

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 4。resident指人；residential形容住宅或居住区。

senses.zh: 港口，口岸；（计算机的）端口；左舷；舱门

ex.en: We watched fishing boats returning to the port.
ex.zh: 我们看着渔船返回港口。

ex.en: Expanding the port could increase international trade, but it may also damage nearby marine habitats.
ex.zh: 扩建港口可能促进国际贸易，但也可能破坏附近的海洋生境。

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 4。port指左舷时，反义词是starboard（右舷）。

senses.zh: 使搁浅；使陷于困境；弄断；使落后

ex.en: A strand of hair fell across her face.
ex.zh: 一缕头发垂到了她的脸上。

ex.en: Improving public transport is one strand of a broader strategy to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通是减少城市空气污染这一整体策略的一个方面。

col: a strand of hair｜一缕头发
a strand of an argument｜论证的一个方面
tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 4。一缕头发用a strand of hair；滞留常用be stranded。

ex.en: He refused a cigarette and went for a walk instead.
ex.zh: 他拒绝了递来的香烟，转而出去散步。

ex.en: Higher cigarette taxes may discourage smoking, but accessible support services are also essential for people trying to quit.
ex.zh: 提高香烟税可能有助于减少吸烟，但对尝试戒烟的人来说，便捷的支持服务也必不可少。

col: a packet of cigarettes｜一包香烟
tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 4。可数名词；一包香烟可说a packet of cigarettes。

senses.zh: 减轻，缓和；放松；灵活地移动

ex.en: A warm bath helped ease the pain in my shoulders.
ex.zh: 洗个热水澡帮助缓解了我的肩痛。

ex.en: Improving public transport could ease traffic congestion while making employment opportunities more accessible to suburban residents.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，同时让郊区居民更容易获得就业机会。

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 4。with ease指毫不费力；at ease指自在放松。

senses.zh: 油门；催化剂； 加速装置

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 4

ex.en: These sturdy boots keep my feet dry on muddy walks.
ex.zh: 穿着这双结实的靴子走泥路，我的双脚也能保持干爽。

ex.en: Schools in earthquake-prone regions need sturdy buildings that can protect students during periods of intense shaking.
ex.zh: 地震多发地区的学校需要坚固的建筑，以便在剧烈震动时保护学生。

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 4。常形容鞋、家具、建筑结实，也可形容人强健。

senses.zh: 用管道输送；尖声唱；用管乐器演奏

ex.en: Water dripped from a broken pipe under the sink.
ex.zh: 水从洗涤槽下面一根破裂的管子里滴下来。

ex.en: Replacing damaged water pipes can help cities conserve resources and ensure a reliable supply of clean drinking water.
ex.zh: 更换受损水管可以帮助城市节约资源，并确保清洁饮用水的可靠供应。

col: pipe water to｜用管道把水输送到
tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 4。pipe可作动词：pipe water to把水输送到某处。

ex.en: The walk to the lake takes roughly twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 步行到湖边大约需要二十分钟。

ex.en: Roughly half of the residents surveyed supported replacing the old car park with a public garden.
ex.zh: 受访居民中约有一半支持将旧停车场改为公共花园。

tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 4。表示“大约”时常放在数量前；也可指动作粗暴。

ex.en: We shifted the sofa closer to the window.
ex.zh: 我们把沙发往窗边挪了挪。

ex.en: Governments should shift investment towards public transport to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 政府应将投资转向公共交通，以缓解交通拥堵和城市空气污染。

col: a shift in attitudes｜态度的转变
tip: 📘 选必2 Listening and Viewing Unit 4。shift作名词可指变化，也可指工作班次。
